top_signals.title: Ex-Google Engineer May Face New Charges Over Bets on Gemini 3.0
top_signals.summary: A former Google software engineer accused of making an illegal bet on Polymarket about company search data may face additional charges that he also traded on the release date of its Gemini 3.0 artificial-intelligence model.

top_signals.title: Copper Heads for Longest Weekly Losing Streak in Two Years
top_signals.summary: Nvidia (Nasdaq: NVDA) beat Wall Street’s revenue forecast by about $6.7 billion on Tuesday night, and copper fell for a fifth straight session on Wednesday. Three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange was down 3.6% at $12,763 a metric ton in early London trading, according to Investing.com. Bloomberg had earlier reported a low of $13,019, the weakest since June 24, with the metal on course for its longest streak of weekly declines in two years. Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in fiscal third-quarter revenue against the $109.1 billion analysts…

top_signals.title: Google Signs Landmark Superhot Geothermal Deal
top_signals.summary: The AI boom and the hyperscalers’ need for round-the-clock clean energy for their data centers meet the next-generation geothermal energy technologies developed by a number of start-ups. In a world first, Google this week signed an agreement with Quaise Energy to use power from the superhot rocks in the Newberry Volcano in Oregon for its existing data center operations in The Dalles. Quaise Energy, which develops utility-scale superhot geothermal energy, has signed a power purchase agreement (PPA) under which Google will buy 50 megawatts…
